description:
WITTMANN is the only manufacturer offering plastic processors worldwide a complete range of innovative robot automation and injection molding machine technology, along with auxiliary equipment for material conveying, blending, drying, granulating, heating and cooling. We provide ONE-STOP SHOP solutions for individual work cells to fully integrated systems and have the advantage of providing the technology to incorporate everything together. Our robots are ideally suited to control various downstream automation systems. Over the years we have implemented thousands of demanding and complicated downstream applications, performing value-adding operations and increasing consistency and part quality. 

Our Software Department is developing technology at the forefront and core of Wittmann. Our team comprises software engineering and product professionals who have launched and maintained brands that are now familiar names in the Plastics Industry. For more information on Wittmann products and services please visit our website.

We are looking for C# / .NET Front-End developers to be part of a dynamic team working on various desktop and embedded applications. 

Ideal Candidate:

  • Graduate/Junior/Intermediate level of work experience in the development of C# applications.
  • Good programming skills in C# ( WPF, Avalonia )
  • Completed studies in computer science or mechatronics
  • Experience in the implementation of MVC and MVVM; using Prism is a plus
  • Experience in test-driven development (TDD) is a plus
  • Good knowledge of spoken and written English
  • Good interpersonal and teamwork skills

Key responsibilities:

  • Designing, coding, testing programs and maintaining solutions based on .NET Framework and .NET Core technologies
  • Take ownership of the existing codebase and adhere to existing development guidelines
  • Develop enhancements based on functional specifications
  • Analyse functional specification for completeness, clarity and feasibility of implementation
  • Investigate problems, perform root-cause analysis and deliver bug fixes
  • Test your own code and peer-test other developers’ code
  • Reading and interpreting pre-existing code
  • Develop code to extend existing shared libraries
  • Investigate and develop skills in new technologies
  • Contribute to finding the right technical solutions and ensuring quality through good design

Our offer:

  • Permanent employment contract
  • Premium medical services
  • Challenging job in a professional and multinational environment
  • Opportunity to gain skills, knowledge and experience
  • Hybrid work ( 2 flexible home office days per week )

Please send your CV in English!
